name: contract-answerer
description: This project was custom-built to provide expert advice on contracts for users, such as union members and representatives. The goal is to streamline the process of getting contract-related information, reducing the need to navigate complex documents and systems. Recognizing the potential for automation, I utilized my programming skills to develop this tool. The application is designed to be user-friendly, efficient, and informative, ensuring that users receive accurate responses to their inquiries.
